messages:
sam: Quick sync — planning a maintenance window Tue 2026-06-01 00:00–03:00 UTC: kernel patches on Dedicated + runtime pin refresh. Need a short status page snippet and SMS blurb for EU opt-ins. Can someone do a fast pass?

maria: I have drafts ready. Short status snippet + detailed email. Pasting both.

maria: ```\nStatus (short):\nPlanned maintenance Tue 2026-06-01 00:00–03:00 UTC. Applying kernel updates and runtime pinning. Brief latency spikes possible; no expected downtime. Live updates will appear on the status page.\n```\n
maria: ```\nEmail (detailed):\nHello,\nWe will perform planned maintenance on Tue 2026-06-01 from 00:00 to 03:00 UTC to apply kernel patches and refresh runtime version pins on Dedicated clusters. You may observe brief latency increases for in-flight requests; service interruption is not expected. We will run post-maint smoke tests across regions and publish a success marker.\n\nWork includes:\n- Kernel patching on Dedicated hosts\n- Runtime pin/rollback config refresh\n- KV cache priming (non-disruptive)\n\nIf you require strict tail-latency guarantees or a pinned model variant during the window, reply and we'll coordinate a temporary hold.\n\nThanks,\nRedwood Platform Team\n```\n
support-jordan: Please add: SMS fallback for opted-in accounts (send local time strings), one line for embeddings customers (billing unaffected), and a line clarifying no change to data residency/exports.

legal-ella: Change absolute wording: use "not expected" rather than "no downtime". Keep rollback language high-level.

ops-maya: Add post-maint validation: "We will run cross-region smoke checks and post results" — helps CS triage.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: maintenance ticket MAINT-20260601-01 scheduled. Automated updates every 15m during window; ticket will auto-close 30m after successful smoke checks.

maria: Updated draft and pushed to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/maintenance/mainti-1759000000-draft (internal).

sam: Translation plan: publish EN + FR + DE for the drill. JP/KR pending (vendor if needed). Support will queue SMS at 01:00 UTC for EU opt-ins.

support-jordan: SMS draft for EU opt-ins: "Redwood planned maintenance Tue 01 Jun 00:00-03:00 UTC. Brief latency may occur. Details: https://status.redwood.ai/MAINT-20260601 (DRILL)." Will include local time in send. CSV queued.

statusbot: Status page (DRILL) posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/MAINT-20260601-drill \n

sam: Publishing EN + FR + DE drill entries now, marking JP/KR pending. If no objections I'll trigger SMS at 01:00 UTC and run the ops drill.

legal-ella: Wording approved.

ops-maya: Preflight smoke checks scheduled 30m before window; will post markers and confirm operations status.

support-jordan: SMS queued & validated; will confirm after send.

sam: Thanks all — closing thread; will reopen if translations or SLA flags surface. Reopen for edits to the status entry if needed.
